## Analytics  (type-only)
interface Analytics<E extends EventMap = EventMap> {
    readonly session: string;
    readonly pending: number;
    emit<K extends keyof (E & EngineEvents) & string>(name: K, ...props: Args<E & EngineEvents, K>): void;
    flush(): Promise<void>;
    attach(ctx: AttachTarget): () => void;
}

## AnalyticsContext  (type-only)
type AnalyticsContext = Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>;

## AnalyticsEvent  (type-only)
interface AnalyticsEvent<N extends string = string, P = unknown> {
    readonly name: N;
    readonly props: P;
    readonly session: string;
    readonly seq: number;
    readonly t: number;
    readonly context?: AnalyticsContext;
}

## AnalyticsOptions  (type-only)
interface AnalyticsOptions {
    sink: AnalyticsSink;
    session?: string;
    clock?: () => number;
    context?: AnalyticsContext;
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
    maxBatch?: number;
}

## AnalyticsSink  (type-only)
type AnalyticsSink = (events: AnalyticsEvent[]) => void | Promise<void>;

## AttachTarget  (type-only)
type AttachTarget = Pick<EngineCtx, 'hooks' | 'host'> & Partial<Pick<EngineCtx, 'ui' | 'surface'>>;

## EngineEvents  (type-only)
interface EngineEvents {
    game_start: {
        formFactor: FormFactor;
        deviceKind: HostKind;
        dpr: number;
        viewport: {
            width: number;
            height: number;
        };
        embed: EmbedContext;
        build: string | null;
    };
    session_end: {
        durationMs: number;
        reason: SessionEndReason;
    };
    device_lost: {
        reason: string;
        message: string;
    };
}

## SessionEndReason  (type-only)
type SessionEndReason = HideReason | 'deviceLost';

## createAnalytics
function createAnalytics<E extends EventMap = EventMap>(opts: AnalyticsOptions): Analytics<E>;
